services.name: Kayaking and Water Activities
services.desc: Rafting on rivers in JCPOS is subject to any restrictions that are placed by the Jefferson County Sheriff’s Office or local police departments. Stay informed as to any current restrictions. Some construction activity on the Clear Creek Segment of the Clear Creek Trail will occasionally affect put-in and take-out

services.name: Horseback Riding
services.desc: All of our parks, except the Lookout Mountain Nature Center and Preserve and Mount Galbraith Park, are open to horses and pack animals. Equestrian-friendly campsites are located within White Ranch and Reynolds
